name: @pipeworx/mcp-horoscope

tools.name: daily_horoscope
tools.description: Get the daily horoscope for a zodiac sign. Returns the prediction text for a given day (today, tomorrow, yesterday, or a specific YYYY-MM-DD date). Useful for "what is my horoscope today" style questions.

sign.description: Zodiac sign (case-insensitive). One of: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces.

day.description: Day to fetch. One of TODAY, TOMORROW, YESTERDAY, or a date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to TODAY.

tools.name: weekly_horoscope
tools.description: Get the weekly horoscope for a zodiac sign. Returns the prediction text covering the current week.

sign.description: Zodiac sign (case-insensitive). One of: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces.

tools.name: monthly_horoscope
tools.description: Get the monthly horoscope for a zodiac sign. Returns the prediction text for the current month plus challenging and standout days.

sign.description: Zodiac sign (case-insensitive). One of: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-horoscope forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the horoscope pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
